title: Response Toolkit
subtitle: Concrete Action Models
description: Don't freeze. Here are ready-made words and plans, so you know exactly what to do.

acute_scripts.intro_text:
Three steps to manage chaos.
1. Stop: Pause your reaction (breathe).
2. Speak: Set the boundary.
3. Document: Write it down immediately.

public_mockery.title: Public Mockery
public_mockery.script: I do not like this comment. Stop it immediately.
public_mockery.nuance: Calm, low voice. No smiling. Eye contact.

withholding_info.title: Withholding Info
withholding_info.script: I need this information for my work. Send it now.
withholding_info.nuance: Don't ask 'could you'. State the need. CC a representative if repeated.
withholding_info.next: Screenshot your request. if no answer, send reminder.

isolation.title: Isolation
isolation.script: Why wasn't I invited? Add me in the future.
isolation.nuance: Ask directly in a meeting or chat. Make the invisible visible.
isolation.next: Ask the team: 'Did you notice I was missing?'

difficult_conversation.title: Difficult Conversation Formula
difficult_conversation.intro: Use this 5-step framework in a private discussion.

steps.title: 1. Opening
steps.script: Thank you for coming. I want to discuss our interaction. This is important for my work.
steps.tip: Frame neutrally. Don't blame, invite to discuss.

steps.title: 2. Concrete Example
steps.script: In last Tuesday's meeting you said publicly 'You don't get this'. I experience this as dismissive. How does that sound to you?
steps.tip: State fact (what happened) and impact (how it felt). End with open question.

steps.title: 3. Boundary
steps.script: In the future, I expect the snide remarks to stop. My work flows best without it. Do you agree?
steps.tip: State clear requirement. Don't ask for permission, but commitment.

steps.title: 4. Follow-up & Support
steps.script: How do we ensure this doesn't repeat? Do I need anything from you?
steps.tip: Share responsibility for the solution. 'How do we succeed in this?'

steps.title: 5. Closing & Documentation
steps.script: Thanks for the talk. I'll note this down. Anything to add?
steps.tip: Make it official. Send a memo by email (CC representative).

manager_chain.title: Manager is the Bully?
manager_chain.intro: When power is misused, you must protect yourself with bureaucracy. Don't wait. Document everything.

steps.script: I find [action] inappropriate. I ask you to stop.
I am reporting [Undisputable facts]. I need a clarification.
I need help resolving this. Attached: documentation.
Bullying causes symptoms. I request a statement on work capacity.
Employer has not taken action despite notification.

safety_plan.title: My Safety Plan
safety_plan.intro: Fill this out and save a screenshot on your phone.

form.reaction_placeholder: E.g. I leave the room for 5 mins.
form.phrase_value: I am using my safety plan now – I need help.
form.exit_placeholder: E.g. If no change in 3 weeks -> Sick leave.
form.disclaimer: This is saved only on your device. A screenshot is most recommended.
